# Top-level pip requirements, installed with their dependencies.
# env/locks/pointstream.pip.txt records every resolved version.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128

# torch 2.10.0+cu128 is SAM 3.1's documented pin. Its wheels carry SASS for
# sm_70 to sm_120, so one build serves GV100, RTX 8000, A6000 and RTX 6000 Ada,
# and CUDA 12.8 runs on the hosts' 535 driver through minor-version compatibility.
torch==2.10.0+cu128
torchvision==0.25.0+cu128

# SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex, at the pinned revision (docs/resources.md#models).
sam3 @ git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam3@2345a4ad109ac29c569da749c91d84f10dc08c40
# sam3 requires numpy<2.
numpy==1.26.4
pycocotools
einops
# sam3 imports pkg_resources, which setuptools removed after 80.x.
setuptools==80.9.0

# PointStream itself (pyproject.toml).
opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84
Pillow
PyYAML==6.0.2
zstandard

# VISOR reader: frame-accurate decoding of the EPIC-KITCHENS videos.
av

# Ultralytics' own dependencies except opencv-python; ultralytics itself is in
# no-deps.txt so the headless OpenCV stays the only cv2.
matplotlib
requests
scipy
psutil
polars
ultralytics-thop

# hand_tracking_toolkit (HOT3D-Clips: fisheye cameras, MANO, rasterizer).
webdataset

# HaMeR and WiLoR model code (demo-only detectron2, mmcv and ViTPose excluded).
smplx==0.1.28
pytorch-lightning
yacs
scikit-image
pyrender
trimesh

# DCVC-UF test path.
tqdm
